question: Where can I find a gallery located southwest of Harbor Oaks Hospital, New Baltimore, MI within 110 kilometers?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_DWithin(geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Harbor Oaks Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New Baltimore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MI%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 110000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Harbor Oaks Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New Baltimore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MI%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
